subject: science
description: Effect of concentration, temperature, pressure on equilibrium position
context_summary:
[Wikipedia]
In chemistry, Le Chatelier's principle is a principle used to predict the effect of a change in conditions on chemical equilibrium. Other names include Chatelier's principle, Braun–Le Chatelier principle, Le Chatelier–Braun principle or the equilibrium law.

prerequisites_descriptions.Chemical Equilibrium: Reversible reactions; equilibrium constant Kc, Kp; Le Chatelier's principle
